factor_name: Breadth-Conditioned Directional Flip of Smoothed Volatility-Normalized Relative Strength

calculation.expression: base = rolling_mean_10(((close[t-1]/close[t-21]-1)/annualized_volatility_20[t-1]) - cross_sectional_median); if rolling_mean_5(cross_sectional_breadth_20[t-1]) < 0.40 then signal=-base else signal=base
calculation.description: Compute lagged 20-session return divided by lagged 20-session annualized volatility, cross-sectionally median-center and smooth for ten sessions. When fewer than 40% of assets have positive lagged 20-session returns on average over five sessions, flip the direction to capture stressed-regime reversal; otherwise retain trend direction. The regime and all prices are lagged to the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Full-sample daily paper IC and ICIR pass the benchmark gates on the 15-asset universe. Recent 365-day IC is positive but below the ICIR admission threshold; recent 730-day performance is stronger. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.method: Daily cross-sectional Pearson IC against 10-session forward close-to-close returns; minimum 8 valid instruments per date; no future prices used in signal construction.
